title: The pr-89 review run failed at the pi probe
description:
FOUND 2026-09-23: the factory's automated review of ticks #89 (run_72d10c49bb554187bd355304f826f55d) failed: 'the pi harness exited 0 without answering the probe'.

Same cause as the first pi smoke run: pi's catalog overstates GLM 5.3's output limit, Workers AI answers HTTP 400, and pi -p prints nothing. The run booted at 04:46 UTC on an image built before the GLM correction (ticks #89 / ticfac #34) was deployed.

VERIFIED FIXED: the review of ticks #90 (run_21e63eadc1db490984af1a896a4f512e) ran after the correction - 'harness probe green: pi answered READY' - and posted review comment 5789830319, which found a real defect (the published merge-file contract) that became ticks #91.
acceptance_criteria: A factory PR review on pi/GLM 5.3 boots, answers its probe and posts a review
